Type a circuit or Boolean expressions. The tool says whether it is combinational and shows the truth table. Draft: it changes until Blake approves it.

<noscript><p>The analyser needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>

  import { mount } from "./src/app.js";
  window.analyzer = mount(document.getElementById("analyzer"));
</script>
